title: External video · 2026-11-14
brief: A video built from the owner's own script and recording.

external.script:
[curious] Imagine a phone reveal so convincing, you forget the company hasn’t actually revealed it.

The viral clips show a purple Galaxy S27 Ultra with four cameras.

But as of November 13, 2026, the phone and “Cobalt Violet” are still UNCONFIRMED.

So what actually surfaced?

[serious] On November 12, Tom’s Guide reported dummy units, including a supposed Ultra.

Now, why does that matter?

A dummy copies the outside of a phone. It doesn’t prove the actual device will look the same.

And with studio lighting and camera processing, it’s surprisingly easy to make something that looks like an official reveal.

[skeptical] But there’s something interesting about those cameras.

The dummy units show four rear cameras. Sounds convincing, right?

Except that detail conflicts with other leaks. Ice Universe even claimed the upper-right camera doesn’t exist.

Another rumour suggests Samsung could go with just three lenses, dropping a secondary 10MP telephoto.

[thoughtful] So which phone are you actually looking at?

Right now, it’s a rumour, not a reveal.

The real test is simple: wait for Samsung’s official announcement, not a dummy under studio lights.

Follow us for more AI and technology updates. The free guide and community link are in the description.

Until then, that purple phone is evidence of a leak, not proof of what ships.
